cq_coverage.CQ3: RoleAssignment hasRole AgentRole (for Organization S, query RoleAssignment with hasOrganization S).
cq_coverage.CQ4: RoleAssignment hasRole 'Buyer' and hasOrganization Organization (filter for Buyer role).
cq_coverage.CQ5: Organization data properties (organizationName, hasIdentifier), Address via RoleAssignment.
cq_coverage.CQ6: RoleAssignment for Buyer hasAddress Address (addressLine, postalCode, city, countryCode).
cq_coverage.CQ8: Item data properties (itemName, itemDescription), LineItem (quantity), Price (netPrice).
cq_coverage.CQ13: Identifier with identifierType, identifierValue; required segments (Header, Detail, Summary), SHACL constraints (not modeled in OWL but structure supports mandatory fields).

pitfalls.name: Inverse relationships not explicitly declared
pitfalls.description: This pitfall appears when any relationship (except for those that are defined as symmetric properties using owl:SymmetricProperty) does not have an inverse relationship (owl:inverseOf) defined within the ontology.

iterations.fix_applied: Will add owl:inverseOf for all relevant object properties.
